summary: Phase 41 Session 6.A — Creator Revenue Share (Earnings + MOCKED Stripe Connect + MOCKED payouts) + 3 P1 fixes (sidebar nav, news_radio RJ scripts, /radio Community Radio strip) backend tested via pytest (14 pass / 2 xfail). FE not exercised in this iteration due to two backend gaps that materially affect the FE story: (1) /api/radio/next crashes with KeyError 'track_id' the moment a news_anchor segment is built, so the very feature the P1 #1 fix targets is unreachable via the documented flow — script CANNOT be validated through the API; (2) the two re-rolled DFW channel thumbnails serve OK (200, image/webp) but the channels themselves are absent from /api/channels (12 channels returned, no dfw_* slugs), so the P1 #2 ‘confirm thumbnail_url on channel doc’ requirement can’t pass. All other backend deliverables (Earnings 30d/7d, owner/non-owner gating with permission_denied, Stripe Connect MOCKED onboard/activate/status, payout request + list, admin ledger + direct_deal, /api/community/top_listened with tier_used + limit cap at 50, openapi route listing) work as specified.

critical.issue: 500 Internal Server Error with KeyError: 'track_id' at server.py:3865 when next segment is a news_anchor (track=None). Blocks all news_radio listening past the first track. Fix: guard with seg.get('track_id') and skip the played/recent_artists bookkeeping for non-track segments.

minor.issue: dfw_bollywood_drive and dfw_garba_nights are not surfaced in /api/channels for any tested user (test/admin) or market query. Only 12 Dubai/global channel slugs returned. The thumbnails were regenerated and ARE served correctly at /api/static/channel_thumbnails/<slug>.webp, but the spec line ‘channels have a thumbnail_url’ cannot be verified because those channel docs are not exposed.
Spec described key 'status' but actual response uses 'stripe_connect_status' (status endpoint) / both 'stripe_connect_status' (activate). Cosmetic schema drift; tests accept either.
Returns {items:[...], count:N} rather than the spec's {payouts:[...]} — cosmetic schema drift.

Recurring 'bigfm.advertiser.seed [adv_seed] E11000 duplicate key error collection: bigfm.advertisers index: id_1 dup key: {id: null}' on every backend startup — pre-existing, not Session 6.A regression.

integration_issues.issue: Cannot validate the new news anchor script in the UI either, because /api/radio/next 500s on the news_anchor segment. The frontend will hit the same 500 the first time it advances past the lead-in track.

rca of the issue: RCA for the radio/next 500: server.py:3865 `if seg['track_id'] not in played:` was written assuming seg always carries a track. The Phase 40 news_anchor branch (server.py:3036-3050) explicitly sets `'track': None` and does NOT include a 'track_id' key in the returned dict — so the dict subscript raises KeyError the moment that segment is consumed by /radio/next. Mitigation: change to `tid = seg.get('track_id'); if tid and tid not in played: played = played + [tid]` and similarly guard the recent_artists update with seg.get('track_artist'). Reproduction: login as test@bigfm.dubai → POST /api/radio/start {channel:'news_radio'} → GET /api/radio/next?session_id=<id> → observe 500.
